title: U.S. House · New Hampshire's 2nd District
area: Western and northern New Hampshire, including Nashua, Concord and Keene.

candidates.name: Maggie Goodlander

summary.text: Maggie Goodlander is the Democratic incumbent seeking re-election in New Hampshire's 2nd Congressional District. Before Congress she worked as a Senate foreign policy advisor, a Navy Reserve intelligence officer, a Supreme Court law clerk, a constitutional law professor, and a deputy assistant attorney general at the Justice Department, and serves on the House Armed Services and Small Business Committees.

background.text: Earned a bachelor's degree in history from Yale University in 2009 and a J.D. from Yale Law School in 2016.

Worked as a foreign policy advisor in the U.S. Senate, an intelligence officer in the U.S. Navy Reserve, a law clerk on the U.S. Supreme Court, and a professor of constitutional law at the University of New Hampshire and Dartmouth.
Served as a deputy assistant attorney general for the U.S. Department of Justice and as a senior advisor at the White House.

record.text: Sits on the House Committee on Armed Services (Military Personnel; Tactical Air and Land Forces subcommittees) and the House Committee on Small Business (Economic Growth, Tax, and Capital Access; Oversight, Investigations, and Regulations; and Rural Development, Energy, and Supply Chains subcommittees) in the 119th Congress.

candidates.researchNotes: Goodlander's official House website's issues page was unreachable (404) at the time of research, so stated priorities and issue positions beyond committee assignments were not located. Her key floor votes and FEC finance totals are added separately by script.

candidates.name: Lily Williams

summary.text: Lily Williams is the Republican nominee for New Hampshire's 2nd Congressional District. She is a real estate investor and business owner running on a government-reform platform, including congressional term limits and single-subject bills.

background.text: Born in Chengdu, China; earned a bachelor's degree from Fudan University in 1985 and a graduate degree from the University of Texas at Austin in 1991.
Career experience includes working as a real estate investor, buyer's agent, entrepreneur, business owner, legal consultant, and medical social worker.

priorities.text: Her campaign describes a "10-Point Good Government Plan" that includes congressional term limits (three terms for U.S. House members, two for senators), requiring single-subject bills, ending funding by continuing resolutions, and banning stock trading by members of Congress.

candidates.researchNotes: Williams has not completed Ballotpedia's 2026 Candidate Connection survey; priorities drawn from her campaign website as quoted by Ballotpedia. No documented stance on the fixed issue list was found in the time available.

candidates.name: Robbie Mahrou

summary.text: Robbie Mahrou is an independent candidate for New Hampshire's 2nd Congressional District. He has worked as a consultant.

background.text: Earned a bachelor's degree from Baylor University in 1999.
Career experience includes working as a consultant.
